title: Scaffold Ebitengine (Go) prototype with async subprocess handling
description:
## Decision
Switch from Rust/SDL2 to Go/Ebitengine based on:
1. Goroutines + channels ideal for streaming subprocess output
2. Go is highly LLM-friendly (easy for AI to write)
3. Ebitengine is mature, stable API, lightweight 2D
4. Single binary output, cross-platform

## Scope
- [ ] Initialize Go module with Ebitengine dependency
- [ ] Basic game window with tile grid placeholder
- [ ] Goroutine that spawns `claude --output-format json` 
- [ ] Channel-based event system (subprocess -> game loop)
- [ ] Simple fog of war state (revealed/hidden per tile)
- [ ] Keyboard input handling (vim-style navigation)
- [ ] Prompt input area (bottom of screen)

## Out of Scope (for this task)
- Advisors, belts, buildings, units
- Real codebase parsing
- Production deployment visualization

title: Use golang.org/x/mod/modfile for go.mod parsing
description:
The current implementation in internal/dependency/extract.go:54-59 uses simple line-based parsing of go.mod files, which doesn't handle multi-line module declarations or comments correctly.

Recommendation: Use golang.org/x/mod/modfile package for robust go.mod parsing.

Reference: Phase 4 PR review

title: Add validation for delve adapter cwd parameter
description:
In internal/debug/delve/adapter.go:98, the cwd parameter is passed to exec.Command without validation. If cwd contains special characters or doesn't exist, this could fail unexpectedly.

Recommendation: Add path validation before setting cmd.Dir to ensure the directory exists and is safe.

Reference: Phase 4 PR review

title: Fix race condition in delve adapter Disconnect method
description:
In internal/debug/delve/adapter.go:248-251, there's a potential race between deleting from the session map and accessing state.cmd. If another goroutine tries to access the session between unlock and signal, it could panic.

Recommendation: Keep the lock until cleanup is complete or use a local copy of state before unlocking.

Reference: Phase 4 PR review

title: Optimize gen-bazelrc-user.sh file scanning
description:
The script scripts/gen-bazelrc-user.sh:44 uses 'find /nix/store -maxdepth 1' which can be slow on large Nix stores with thousands of entries.

Recommendation: Cache the find results or use a more targeted approach to improve performance.

Reference: Phase 4 PR review

Recommendation: Add integration tests that verify package interactions for circular dependency detection.

title: Screenshot testing infrastructure
description:
Add the ability to capture and compare game screenshots during testing. This enables visual regression testing and allows agents to verify UI changes.

## Motivation
- Tests currently run in xvfb but cannot see the output
- Agents cannot verify UI changes visually
- Rendering bugs could ship unnoticed

## Components
1. Screenshot capture utility (internal/testutil/screenshot.go)
2. Image comparison utilities
3. CI artifact upload for screenshots
4. Documentation in CLAUDE.md

title: Screenshot capture utility
description:
Create internal/testutil/screenshot.go with:
- CaptureScreen() function to save game screen to PNG
- SaveToFile() for writing to disk
- Integration with Ebitengine's image APIs

title: Image comparison utility
description:
Create internal/testutil/compare.go with:
- CompareImages() for pixel-by-pixel comparison
- DiffImage() to generate visual diff
- Threshold-based matching for minor variations

title: CI screenshot artifacts
description:

- Upload screenshots as workflow artifacts on test failure
- Store in known location for agent access
